title: Deployment Service Profile
description: Per-deployment service selection. Lives at .local/deployments/<slug>/profile.yml. Composes named profiles from inventory/group_vars/all/service_profiles.yml plus per-deployment opt-ins, opt-outs, and overrides. ADR 0441.

profiles.description: Named profiles to include. Resolved depth-first via the catalog's `extends` graph. Each profile's services are unioned together.

extra_services.description: Services not in any selected profile that should still run on this deployment.

disabled_services.description: Hard-disable list. Removes services that profile expansion would otherwise enable. If a kept service requires a disabled one, validation fails.

service_overrides.description: Per-service tuning. Keys are service names; values are merged onto the catalog defaults via deep merge for dicts and replacement for lists/scalars.
